title: Adventurer’s Shop
shortDescription: Stock the shelves. Set your prices. Charm the occasional wizard.
description: Run a small fantasy shop through a seven-day trading campaign. Buy inventory, set prices, react to daily events, and sell to peasants, warriors, and mages. Keep enough gold for the rent.
coverAlt: Adventurer’s Shop gameplay showing an illustrated shop counter, shelves, and customers
controls: Buy stock with the on-screen buttons and enter prices or use the minus and plus buttons.
Open the shop to start trading. Customers arrive automatically; you can change prices and restock during sales.
Space pauses trading. Escape closes help or dialogs. On mobile, use the bottom tabs for the shop, goods, and upgrades.
saveNote: Saves locally every two seconds and when leaving. A hidden or restored trading session pauses. No earnings accrue while the game is closed.
